statements.status_notes: Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1326 (merge commit 5935b102a528a85401ff982263b176c28df26618), which correctly treats getentropy() returning zero as success and preserves strong entropy for hash-flooding protection.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1321 (merge commit e97a6c453a4ef0595953e3f72f64ad1b74afc96a), which migrates storeAtts() isCdata lookup from a linear scan to a hash table and removes the quadratic CPU complexity.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1326 (merge commit 5935b102a528a85401ff982263b176c28df26618), which correctly treats getentropy() returning zero as success and preserves strong entropy for hash-flooding protection.

Fixed in DHI expat 2.8.3-r1 by backporting upstream libexpat PR #1321 (merge commit e97a6c453a4ef0595953e3f72f64ad1b74afc96a), which migrates storeAtts() isCdata lookup from a linear scan to a hash table and removes the quadratic CPU complexity.

The DHI BusyBox APK backports the upstream ash evalfun() fix as dhi-cve-2026-38755-ash-function-recursion.patch, enforcing a bounded shell-function recursion depth. Source: https://lists.busybox.net/pipermail/busybox/2026-June/092354.html

The DHI BusyBox APK applies Alpine's ash ifsbreakup() backport as dhi-cve-2026-38754-ash-ifsbreakup-bounds.patch, clearing stale IFS state after expansion errors. Source: https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/master/main/busybox/0040-ash-fix-out-of-bounds-read-in-ifsbreakup.patch

The DHI BusyBox APK backports the upstream awk_sub() fix as dhi-cve-2026-38753-awk-sub-use-after-free.patch, copying replacement text before regular-expression evaluation can invalidate its backing storage. Source: https://lists.busybox.net/pipermail/busybox/2026-June/092352.html
